production_default.route: one-plane MMQ selected gate/up and down
production_default.scratch_reuse: gate/up BF16 output temporarily occupies the larger selected-down allocation; packed Q8 reuses the existing gate/up allocation
production_default.composite: explicit-BF16-boundary dual-SiLU plus range-safe Q8_1 D4 pack
production_default.arithmetic: evaluate the established SiLU expression, BF16-round, convert that rounded value to F32, then run the established FP32-metadata residual pack
production_default.physical_change: remove one 512x10240 selected-SiLU BF16 materialization and one launch per sparse layer
production_default.fallback: registered standalone selected SiLU plus ordinary Q8 pack primitive chain

selector_unset.command: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=1 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python3 -u scripts/laguna_long_context_profile.py --lengths 512,1024,4096 --chunk-size 512 --repetitions 3 --warmup-rows 128 --compiler-version-file /tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt --require-cached-build --output /tmp/laguna-fused-silu-pack-production-clean.json

rocprof.command: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=1 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 PYTHONPATH=. rocprofv3 --kernel-trace --output-format csv -d /tmp/laguna-fused-silu-pack-production-rocprof -- .venv/bin/python3 -u scripts/laguna_long_context_profile.py --lengths 512,1024,4096 --chunk-size 512 --repetitions 1 --warmup-rows 128 --compiler-version-file /tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt --require-cached-build --output /tmp/laguna-fused-silu-pack-production-rocprof.json

correctness.transfer_basis: The fused body explicitly preserves the standalone SiLU BF16 boundary. Production-shape Q4_K and Q6_K complete MoE outputs are byte-identical, and seven complete-state A/B pairs preserve token, token logit, full logits, final and post-layer hidden, KV, and cursor.
